title: Now Where They At?
description: Learn the true stories behind the scenes about your favorite actors, musicians, and sports heroes. Find out what they’re up to now, years after fading from the limelight.
quote: Today, these one-hit nobodies are on the “no one cares” train to Nowheresville.
